summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting  ### What I found from a read-only audit (no code changed) I traced the full path: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `/api/watchlist` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` → SQLite.  - The client has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback and no anonymous ID — every read/write goes through `api.get/post/delete` with `credentials: "include"`. - `watchlistRouter` has its own auth middleware (not the server-level one) that requires a valid `arca_session` cookie, resolves it via `getSession()`, and injects `X-User-Id` from the **server-side session
